risks.title: Post-merger integration risk
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first among business and strategic risks related to the merger with Independent Bank Group completed on January 1, 2025. Language emphasizes uncertainties and potential negative impacts on financial performance and stock valuation. Assets increased by 45.1%, reflecting the scale of integration.

risks.title: Growth management risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is ranked first among business and strategic risks. The text uses strong language ('material adverse effect') to describe potential consequences of poor growth management, particularly on strategy and financial results.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed and ranked first among business risks. The intensity of the language ('negatively impact', 'decrease') and reliance on net interest income highlight its criticality. The current economic context with fluctuating rates reinforces this risk.

risks.title: Inflation and economic conditions risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly mentioned and its impact on the company and profitability is emphasized. The language ('negative impact', 'persist for longer periods') indicates significant concern. The context of persistent inflation makes it more relevant.

risks.title: Credit and client default risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned multiple times, particularly in the context of commercial and real estate loan portfolios. The language ('higher risks', 'default by our clients') and reference to credit risk management indicate major importance.

risks.title: Technological and AI adoption risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the context of strategy and evolution of the business model. The language ('may have fewer resources', 'pace of adoption') suggests concern about the ability to keep up with technological change and AI adoption.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and systems security risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly and repeatedly mentioned, with strong language ('failure or disruption', 'cyber-attacks', 'information security breaches'). The importance of IT systems and third-party vendors is emphasized.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented as a distinct category. The language ('could limit or restrict', 'obligation to comply') indicates a significant constraint for the company. The nature of the banking sector makes this risk structurally high.

ai_positioning.summary: SouthState Bank Corporation recognizes the importance of artificial intelligence in its industry and identifies the pace of AI adoption by its own operations and third-party providers as a strategic risk factor. The company does not detail a specific AI strategy but acknowledges the need to invest in technological improvements to remain competitive.
evidence: Risk factor explicitly mentioning 'the pace of adoption and use of artificial intelligence tools by us and our third-party vendors and service providers'
Reference to potential resource constraints relative to competitors for technological improvements including AI
Acknowledgment that technological changes including AI impact the business model
